entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Guillaume Joseph Gabriel de La Landelle was a French naval officer, journalist, and writer, a seafaring novelist, and author of other maritime works. He was also one of the pioneers of aeronautics. He served in the navy and authored several novels that depict maritime customs and naval warfare.
